pipelines.sql: SELECT window_start, window_end, asn, count(*) AS n FROM indicators GROUP BY tumble(INTERVAL '5 minutes'), asn HAVING count(*) > 50
SELECT window_start, window_end, asn, count(*) AS n FROM indicators GROUP BY tumble(INTERVAL '5 minutes'), asn

SELECT window_start, window_end, kind, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT asn) AS asns, sum(asn) AS s, min(asn) AS lo, max(asn) AS hi, avg(asn) AS av FROM indicators WHERE ip LIKE '10.%' GROUP BY hop(INTERVAL '5 minutes', INTERVAL '1 minute'), kind
SELECT DISTINCT window_start, window_end, kind FROM indicators WHERE asn < 1100 GROUP BY tumble(INTERVAL '5 minutes'), kind, asn
SELECT window_start, window_end, ip FROM indicators WHERE kind = 'malware' AND asn < 1020 GROUP BY tumble(INTERVAL '5 minutes'), ip
SELECT asn, ip, upper(kind) AS kind FROM indicators WHERE asn = 1020
